summary: A granite tower of 1903-05 on the Graves ledges off Boston Harbor, built to mark the sea end of the Broad Sound channel; automated 1976 and privately owned since a record 2013 auction.

lens.status: original removed 1976; privately assembled replacement lens installed 2023

access.note: Privately owned; grounds and tower closed; reachable only by boat and the ledge is mostly awash at high tide.

facts.agency: Private owner (Coast Guard maintains the light as an aid to navigation)

notes_for_editor: Evidence is a modern secondary source (Lighthousefriends, itself citing Light-House Board reports, Boston Globe 1905 and Snow) plus NPS, the Bulletin and the keeper roster. The Light-House Board reports for 1902-1906 are not in the local corpus (lhb ends 1901), and Chronicling America searches returned nothing, so construction dates and costs rest on Anderson and are not independently checked; Putnam confirms only 1903-05, 882 blocks and 380,000 candlepower. Heights differ: NPS 113 ft overall (matches record's 34 m); Anderson 88 ft of masonry and 98 ft focal plane; USLHS lists tower 98 ft, focal 113 ft. Keeper roster: Pearl S. King is head 1923-24 in Anderson but absent from the archive roster; Anderson's first assistants differ slightly from the archive (e.g. Brainard Bailey 1918 vs 1917). The assistant in the Dec 1924 episode is Olsen in Anderson and Anton Olson in the archive; Harry Whin (Anderson) is Harry Whine in the archive. Will A. Clark (Chief Constructing Engineer) has no dates in the archive. The 1935 storm: the Bulletin's two-column OCR is interleaved; the story gives only 'November 1935'. Date of Towle's 1914 rescue is from the Bulletin's 1914 volume. The 1976 lens loss: NPS says lens went into storage at the Smithsonian; the story says only that it was removed. Fact-check 2026-10-27: Day in Dec 1924 was an assistant (Anderson: appointed second assistant; archive: second assistant 1924), not head keeper as first drafted; archive lists Pearl S. King as first assistant 1923-24 where Anderson lists him as head.
